title: MMP v2.0 control-encrypted envelope (§18.2.1)
description: The sealed envelope of one control frame. The plaintext is the minified JSON of one inner frame (control-frame.schema.json and the other inner schemas); the AAD is mmp-aead-control-v2 over version, session, direction and sequence. It shares its direction's sequence counter with cmb-encrypted.

sequence.description: Unsigned decimal, less than 2^96 (the AEAD nonce is the sequence in 96 bits).

sealed.description: Unpadded base64url of the ciphertext followed by the 16-byte Poly1305 tag; at least the tag.
